description: List pending gates: the policy gates (a gate past the server's lazy-expiry timeout is not listed) plus, when no itemId is given, the owner's open questions as owner gates (id owner:<qid>, options with plain-English labels, recommended, version; they never expire; contracts/owner-gate.schema.json). owner_gates says how that list was read: {count} or {unreadable: true, error}, which means unknown, never zero.

itemId.description: Filter to policy gates for a specific item (optional; owner gates are then left out)

name: get_pending_gates
